title: Two things to unblock the dsd-vps run
description: Server prep is done (PG 18 installed, 54M-row dump restored, indexes building). To run the actual dsd-vps deploy and finish, I need these two answers.

questions.question: dsd-vps 0.1.1 connects as root with a password (DSD_HOST_PW env var; key support is open issue #18). Paste the droplet's root password so I can export it and run `manage.py deploy`. (You can rotate it afterwards from the DO panel if you prefer.)
The server's post-receive hook (generated by dsd-vps) hardcodes checking out `main`, but our work is on the `dsd-vps` branch. How should the push happen?

options.label: Merge `dsd-vps` into `main` locally and push `main` to the server. Also push `main` to GitHub (caktus/talk-fuzzy-name-search) so the deploy matches the published repo.
Merge into local `main` and push only to the server — leave GitHub alone for now (I'll sync later).
Edit the server's post-receive hook to track the `dsd-vps` branch instead (one small customization, against the 'minimize customizations' goal).
